1.title: EasyJet agrees to surprise takeover bid as rival US firm swoops in
1.summary: The airline says a bid from US firm Apollo has trumped a recent takeover offer from Castlelake.

2.title: Top Senate Democratic PAC Stockpiles Record Sum, as Money Chase Heats Up
2.summary: Senate Majority PAC says it entered July with $126 million, a new midyear high, after raising $147 million with an affiliated nonprofit from April through June. But can it keep pace with the G.O.P.?

3.title: Why Some Women in Maine Are Mourning the End of Graham Platner’s Campaign
3.summary: They believe the accuser, but they also grieve the demise of a campaign that promised that politics could be different — and they blame those who failed to find a less flawed candidate.

4.title: At Least 11 People Die in Southern Spain Wildfire
4.summary: The blaze in Andalusia prompted a major containment operation. Heat waves across Europe this summer have raised the risk of such fires, forecasters say.

5.title: East Asia braces for destructive typhoon as landslides kill 15 in Philippines
5.summary: Headed for Taiwan and south-eastern China, the 1,000 km-wide Bavi is forecast to be one of the strongest storms in decades.

6.title: Moscow Still Has Art and Culture. Just Don’t Say ‘Ukraine.’
6.summary: An eerie limbo prevails at small art shows, independent theaters and private political clubs, where the war is the elephant in the room.
